description: Kystdata is the coastal data service on the kyst.dk site of the Danish Environmental Protection Agency (Miljøstyrelsen). The agency surveys, collects and processes data on tides, high water, watercourses, water levels, sluices, wave measurements and weather measurements, and the page gives access to all data from these surveys with descriptions of the survey methods, grouped as tides, high water statistics, watercourse data, sluice data, water level measurements, wave measurements, weather measurements and other data. Coastal information is also shown in the Kystatlas web GIS application. Access to the data pages is free; no licence is stated on the page read. Caveats: the page is in Danish and the series sit on separate sub-pages. Coverage is the Danish coast. It supports hazard exposure and climate adaptation analysis for coastal flooding of ports, roads, railways and settlements, such as setting design levels for coastal protection; related records are the Danish high water statistics and the NNRCMP coastal monitoring data.
